mentions.name: Teeworlds on CKB-VM
mentions.description: A port of the Teeworlds game to CKB-VM, a RISC-V virtual machine designed for the Nervos blockchain, running real game logic such as the game loop, physics simulation, and collision detection on the VM.
mentions.problem: Exploring how far modern blockchain VMs can be pushed by running real game workloads on them.
mentions.author: xuejie
